_meta.purpose: Per-loan scenario applicability overlay -- NOT_APPLICABLE rows here are checks whose trigger condition is provably false against this specific loan's verified facts, cited per row. Provisional pending spot-check (see plan section A2) before being trusted as ground truth for wiring.
_meta.method: 6 parallel LLM judges evaluated each check's verbatim gold-ruleset text against a verified scenario profile of the loan (built from demo/touchless/extracted/loan_application.json + the adapter fixture). Disjunction rule enforced in every prompt: an undecidable any_of trigger never resolves to NA -- every alternative must be provably false. See plan section A2 and the conversation transcript (2026-07-31) for the full profile and methodology.
_meta.verdicts: NA = not applicable, cited fact makes the trigger provably false. APPLIES = trigger provably true. UNKNOWN = undecidable from available loan data, stays NO_DATA. NOT_CONDITIONAL = no scenario trigger at all, always applies.
_meta.spot_check_status: DONE (2026-07-31): heuristic scan for pass-argument-shaped NA reasons + 15-row random sample. 2 of 147 NA rows downgraded to UNKNOWN (see original_verdict_pre_spotcheck on affected rows): PC::O-FNM-15447/O-FNM-54539 (the originally-known issue) and PC::O-FNM-15410/O-FNM-50204 (found during this pass). Remaining 145 NA rows and the 15-row random sample read as genuine trigger-is-false arguments, not pass-arguments.
_meta.extension_2026-08-01_needs_review_scopin: Gordon asked to tackle the ~121-check NEEDS_REVIEW bucket. 5 parallel research agents checked all 121 (100% scripted_review type) against the real loan payload for winnable preconditions -- 13 initially flagged winnable, but re-checking two of them against this project's own consistent defect_option convention (each option describes a FAILURE condition; confirming it true is evidence FOR a defect, not against) found 2 were backwards: PC::O-EPD-14458/O-EPD-52922 (gift down payment confirmed present -- that IS the indicator the check is looking for, not evidence against it) and PC::Occupancy/Location (employer-address/property-state mismatch confirmed -- that IS evidence occupancy may not be supported, not evidence it is). Both correctly held back, left as NEEDS_REVIEW/REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW rather than wired to a false-clean PASS. The other 11 are genuine precondition-negation cases (this loan's confirmed property/loan facts make the checks' own trigger scenario impossible) and are added here as NA rows, same schema and same per-option-not-card-level discipline as the original 347-row A2 pass.
_meta.extension_2026-08-01_second_look: Second-look pass over the 8 UNCERTAIN rows + 3 suspected missed precondition-negations from the 121-check NEEDS_REVIEW investigation (see extension_2026-08-01_needs_review_scoping). 3 confirmed and added here, each verified against the option's VERBATIM rule text (not inferred): MA-only septic requirement vs HI property (borrower's MA rental REO checked and excluded -- not the property being transferred), TX 50(a)(6)-only requirement vs HI purchase, and a >95%-LTV-only requirement vs 73.86 across all three populated ratios. The other 8 STAY at NEEDS_REVIEW: two carry affirmative defect-shaped evidence (cashToBorrowerAtClosingAmount=115261.5 on a PURCHASE loan; housingExpenseMonthlyPaymentAmount=50.0, implausible and shock-implying at face value) and must never be auto-cleared; the rest lack the data to decide either way (self-reported declarations are not the credit-record cross-check the rules intend; income typing is not closed-world; title vesting and insurance policy details unextracted; loanConditions all-OPEN staleness is a pending vendor question).
_meta.extension_2026-08-02_assume_no_solar_adu: Gordon's explicit demo-scoped assumption: no solar panels, no ADU, no 4506-C rejection issue on this loan. Applied to 5 of 6 candidate checks -- the 6th (PC::O-FNM-59383, Form 1033 #28) was NOT cleared: its trigger is a two-part disjunction ('an accessory dwelling unit AND/OR additional site features') and 'assume no ADU' only negates half of it -- 'additional site features' is a separate, unaddressed condition, so per the disjunction-safety rule used throughout this session (an undecidable any_of never excludes unless every alternative is proven false) this one stays NEEDS_REVIEW rather than being silently over-cleared.
